Global (All).title: North Korea conducts missile test
Global (All).summary: North Korea has conducted a ballistic missile test, raising concerns about regional security and global tensions.

Global (All).title: European Union imposes sanctions on Russia
Global (All).summary: The European Union has imposed new sanctions on Russia in response to its actions in Ukraine, escalating tensions between the two sides.

Global (All).title: Protests erupt in major Chinese cities
Global (All).summary: Anti-government protests have broken out in several major Chinese cities, highlighting growing discontent with the ruling Communist Party.

United States.title: Tensions between the US and Iran rise over alleged attack on American drone
United States.summary: The US military releases footage of the unmanned aircraft being shot down in international airspace, escalating tensions between Tehran and Washington.

United States.title: US Supreme Court blocks vaccine mandate for large employers
United States.summary: The high court rules 6-3 that the Occupational Safety and Health Administration does not have the authority to impose the mandate.

United States.title: US House Republicans launch ethics probe into Biden's handling of classified documents
United States.summary: The House Republicans are scrutinizing the president's handling of the sensitive materials found at his Delaware home, further politicizing the issue.

South Korea.title: Seoul's COVID-19 outbreak: Authorities confirm new variant
South Korea.summary: Seoul's authorities have confirmed a new COVID-19 variant. The authorities are racing to contain the outbreak and prevent further spread. Residents are advised to take precautions and follow health guidelines.

South Korea.title: South Korea-US joint military exercises spark tension with North Korea
South Korea.summary: South Korea and the US launched joint military exercises, prompting a strong reaction from North Korea. The North Korean government has threatened retaliation, raising concerns about regional stability.

South Korea.title: Anti-government protests erupt in South Korea over economic concerns
South Korea.summary: Anti-government protests broke out in major cities across South Korea, with demonstrators expressing frustration over the country's economic woes and high inflation. The protests have led to clashes with police, with several injured.

Japan.title: Typhoon Mawar hits Japan
Japan.summary: Typhoon Mawar made landfall in Japan on July 23, 2024, causing widespread damage and disruptions. The storm brought strong winds and heavy rains, leading to power outages and flooding in several regions.

Japan.title: Rising COVID-19 cases in Japan
Japan.summary: Japan has seen a rise in COVID-19 cases in the past week, with several clusters reported in major cities. Health officials have urged residents to take precautions and get vaccinated.

Japan.title: Protests against government policies in Tokyo
Japan.summary: Small-scale protests against the Japanese government's policies have been reported in Tokyo in the past week. Demonstrators have been expressing concerns over issues such as economic inequality and labor rights.
